title: Put the World Back: Timestamps Matter in Time Series Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.34848v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to time series reasoning. However, current evaluations often give models events in chronological order and already matched to the time series. This makes it unclear whether models use timestamps to connect events with observations or simply take shortcuts. To expose this ambiguity, we reformulate time series reasoning from a world-to-series projection perspective, viewing timestamps as explicit indices that connect numerical observations and external events to shared world states. We identify three structures that timestamps can make explicit: temporal causal structure, time semantics, and event-series alignment. Building on this perspective, we develop a diagnostic protocol that distinguishes timestamp-grounded reasoning from correlational shortcuts, a distinction that accuracy-based benchmarks cannot make. translated_title: 回归世界本体：时间戳在时间序列推理中至关重要
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正被越来越多地应用于时间序列推理。然而，当前的评估通常按时间顺序向模型提供事件，且事件已预先与时间序列匹配。这使得我们无法判断模型究竟是利用时间戳将事件与观测数据联系起来，还是仅仅走了捷径。为了揭示这一模糊性，我们从“世界到序列的投影”视角重新表述时间序列推理，将时间戳视为显式索引，把数值观测和外部事件连接到共享的世界状态。我们识别出时间戳能够显式化的三种结构：时序因果结构、时间语义以及事件-序列对齐。基于这一视角，我们开发了一种诊断协议，用以区分基于时间戳的推理与相关性捷径——这一区分是基于准确率的基准测试所无法做到的。对来自两个任务的310个问题进行的受控干预实验表明，高准确率……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出从“世界到序列投影”的视角重新定义时间序列推理，将时间戳视为连接数值观测与外部事件、指向共享世界状态的显式索引，并据此开发了首个能区分真正的基于时间戳的推理与相关性捷径的诊断协议，从而暴露了现有基于准确率的评估基准的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates time series reasoning from a world-to-series projection perspective, treating timestamps as explicit indices that connect numerical observations and external events to shared world states, and develops a diagnostic protocol that distinguishes genuine timestamp-grounded reasoning from correlational shortcuts, exposing the limitations of accuracy-based benchmarks.
